verdict.rationale: OpenClaw exposes Gateway HTTP APIs, such as an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface and a tools-invoke endpoint, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found every candidate spec path returning 404. Documented endpoints alone are adjacent material, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
